dataset.attributes: research/kalodata/snapshots/pit_2026-09_v1/attributes_current.parquet (names/sellers as of 2026-10-25, never used as features)
dataset.source_db_access: read-only (sqlite mode=ro); no Kalodata downloads, no credits

primary_outcome.name: S3_sustained
primary_outcome.definition: For a product listed at month t (any category top 500, or riser list positions 1-200): 1 if it is in any category top 500 in at least 2 of the months t+1, t+2, t+3; else 0. NaN if any of those months is after 2026-09 or missing.
primary_outcome.why: A product we would test needs demand that lasts through sourcing (~2-4 weeks) and a test month; a one-month spike is not an opportunity.
primary_outcome.absence_rule: Top-500 lists are complete, so absence from a month's top 500 means 'below the 500th product' (valid 0); absence never means zero sales.

evaluation.population: all products listed at t (top500 + risers 1-200; deep risers 201-1,000 excluded because they exist only in Sep 2026)
evaluation.training: rolling origin, expanding window, embargo 3 months: a model scored at t is trained only on rows with month <= t-3 (labels fully known by t)
metrics: p_cat@10 (mean hit rate of each category's top 10)
evaluation.uncertainty: month-block bootstrap (2000 draws) of the difference vs the best baseline
evaluation.no_weight_tuning: composite weights below are fixed in advance and are not changed after seeing results

rankers.B2_growth: mom_growth = ln(revenue_t/revenue_t-1) when listed both months; missing ranks last
rankers.B3_consistency: number of months listed among t-2, t-1, t; ties broken by revenue_t
rankers.A_emerging: z(mom_growth clipped to [-2, 3]) + z(log10 of positive dollar growth) + 0.5 if grew in both t-1 and t; products with revenue_t < $5,000 rank last
rankers.B_underserved: z(category top-500 revenue growth t/t-1) - z(category seller HHI at t) - z(product's seller share of category) + 0.5*z(log revenue_t)
rankers.M4_existing_spec: logistic regression on the 18 model_v2 features (scripts behind model_v2_2026-10-28), retrained rolling on S3_sustained
rankers.M5_composite: mean of within-month percentile ranks of M4, A_emerging, B3_consistency and B1_sales (equal weights, fixed in advance)

not_backtestable.C_repeatable_video: per-product video data exists only for Sep 2026 (123 products)
not_backtestable.E_margin: supplier costs exist only for 50 Sep 2026 products
not_backtestable.F_bundles: no co-purchase data in the dataset

current_screen.store_fit_reason: Ember & Clove is a women's fashion and accessories store; a product outside this range would need its own store and brand. Market-wide lists are still reported.
current_screen.commercial_eligibility: listed in Sep 2026, TikTok unit price $15-$120, Sep revenue >= $5,000
hard_flags: brand or trademark in the product name (IP risk for a lookalike)
regulated or claims-heavy item (shapewear medical claims, supplements, cosmetics)
no supplier match or a failed photo match
current_screen.missing_components: Provisional market score renormalises weights over the components that exist; a commercial score is given only where supplier economics exist. Missing is never scored as bad.

economics.formula: contribution = price - supplier cost - shipping - (2.9% * price + $0.30) - refund reserve (5% of price); break-even CAC = contribution; break-even ROAS = price / contribution; target CAC = contribution - 20% * price; target ROAS = price / target CAC
economics.price_used: TikTok Sep 2026 unit price (revenue/units) as the reference selling price
economics.source: saved CJ quotes from 2026-10-29 only; no invented costs
